title: Luis Bobadilla Dias, Data Platform Engineer
description: Data Platform Engineer in Asunción, Paraguay, with 6+ years in software and data engineering. I design and run AWS lakehouses with dbt and Airflow, and consult for companies on their data platforms.
tagline: I'm a Data Platform Engineer with 6+ years in software and data engineering, the last 4 in banking and fintech. I design and run data platforms on AWS that hold up in production and that teams can use on their own.
